About:

Lubov is a contemporary art gallery established in 2016 by Francisco Correa Cordero. Lubov commits to artists first by championing overlooked practices and advancing complex thought. Lubov promotes experimental approaches that often exist outside the dominant discourse, institutional structures or mainstream markets.
